annotations.title: Get a One-Time Link to Mint a nittim Key

description: For a client that cannot sign in over OAuth: a short, one-time link to https://nittim.com/keys/claim/<token>. Opening it, signed in, mints a real nittim API key and shows it once — the key itself is NEVER returned by this tool or by any other MCP result. The link expires in a few minutes and works exactly once. Free.

keyName.description: Optional display name for the key that will be minted, e.g. 'my-cursor-key'. Defaults to 'API key'.
